}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== Raspberry Pi logo and "Compute Module 5 IO Board" are silkscreened on IO board top. :Contains [[Raspberry Pi Compute Module 5 (CM5104032)]] {{See also|RPF Raspberry Pi series}}
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Broadcom]] BCM2712 @2.4GHz :SoC: Quad-core ARM (Cortex-A76) *GPU: [[Broadcom]] VideoCore VII :OpenGL ES 3.1, Vulkan 1.2, :H.265 (HEVC) (up to 4Kp60 decode), :H.264 (up to 1080p60 decode, 1080p30 encode) *Storage: 32GB (eMMC 5.1) Flash *Memory: 4 (LPDDR4X) SDRAM *Wi-Fi: [[Cypress]] ([[Infineon]]) CYW43455 (1T1R) :SDIO 3.0: Wi-Fi 802.11ac, UART/PCM: BT 5.0 LE *Network: 1x 1GbE port *USB: 2x USB 3.0 (Host) ports *PCIe: M.2 (M-Key) PCIe 2.0 slot *GPIO: 1x 40-pin headers *Power Source: 5V via USB (Type-C) port
==Links of Interest== *[https://www.cnx-software.com/2024/11/27/raspberry-pi-cm5-broadcom-bcm2712-soc-16gb-lpddr4-ecc-memory/ ''Raspberry Pi CM5 launched with Broadcom BCM2712 SoC'' on '''CNX|Software'''] *[https://linuxgizmos.com/raspberry-pi-officially-launches-compute-module-5-starting-at-45/ ''Raspberry Pi Officially Launches Compute Module 5'' on '''LinuxGizmos''']
